answer: Make each new identity lock a bond that grows with every identity the same operator already holds, so the tenth fake costs far more than the first. A lone falcon can afford one honest bond, but a farmer minting a thousand sock-puppets faces a bill that rises like a comet tail — steep and unavoidable. Confiscated bonds fund an umber reserve that pays honest challengers who expose fakes, turning Sybil farming from cheap spam into a losing trade.
